<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subrogation" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/subrogation">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subrogation" name="Subrogation recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Handler" name="Claims handler" processRef="Process_Subrogation"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Message_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subrogation" name="Subrogation Recourse Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Subrogation" name="Possible subrogation identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInfo" name="Obtain subrogation information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Recourse" name="Recourse possible?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send payment request to insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reminder" name="Create reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Payment, disagreement or deadline?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Message_PaymentReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DisagreementDeadline" name="Disagreement deadline reached without payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Deadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Booking" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClosePaid" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Case closed after payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check insurant's reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reasoning" name="Insurant right?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseDisagreement" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DisagreementAccepted" name="Case closed (insurant right)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ForwardCollection" name="Forward case to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Collection" name="Case handed to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseNoRecourse" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRecourse" name="Case closed (no recourse possible)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Subrogation" targetRef="Task_ObtainInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInfo" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_Recourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Recourse" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Recourse" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Task_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Reminder" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Catch_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_Booking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Catch_Disagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Catch_DisagreementDeadline" targetRef="Task_ForwardCollection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_Booking" targetRef="Task_ClosePaid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ClosePaid" targetRef="End_Paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_Reasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Reasoning" targetRef="Task_CloseDisagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Reasoning" targetRef="Task_ForwardCollection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_CloseDisagreement" targetRef="End_DisagreementAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCollection" targetRef="End_Collection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="End_NoRecourse"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states an action that a participant performs on a parallel branch or as the closing step of the process (for example gathering items for a concurrent preparation branch, or closing the whole process after the final outcome), written as its own sentence: Model each such stated action as its own bpmn:task. For a parallel branch, place the task on that branch between the split and the join, in the participant's lane when lanes exist. For a closing step, place the task before the end event that marks the outcome. Use a start or end event only for the trigger or the final outcome, and do not name an event after the action or represent the action by the event.
rules.situation: the description says that a decision branch ends with a stated action on the case (for example closing it, making a booking, or forwarding it) before the process ends

rules.instruction: When the description says the process ends when one of several outcomes occurs, and one of those outcomes is described as an action that must be carried out (for example, discarding an artifact) before the process ends: Model the action-bearing outcome as a task on its own branch from the decision that selects the outcome, and connect that task to the end event. Do not connect the decision gateway directly to an end event when the outcome requires an action.
rules.situation: the description states that a branch ends with an explicit action that finishes or closes a case, either directly after a decision or after a single step on that path

rules.instruction: When the description says that a branch concludes with an actor performing a closing action on the work item (for example, closing it after a decision or after a payment is received), and that action is named as a step of its own: Model the stated closing action as a task that the responsible actor performs on that branch, placed directly before the branch's end event. Do not connect the decision or the incoming flow straight to the end event, and do not drop the action because the end event already names the outcome. Keep one closing task per branch where the description states such an action.
rules.situation: the description says that a branch concludes with an actor performing a closing action on the work item (for example, closing it after a decision or after a payment is received), and that action is named as a step of its own

rules.instruction: When the description says an event-based choice waits for one of several outcomes, one of which is a timed deadline, and that this timed outcome leads directly on to a further named activity: Model the timed outcome as an intermediate catch event placed directly after the event-based gateway. Connect its outgoing sequence flow straight to the activity the description names for that outcome. Do not insert an exclusive gateway, a merge, or an end event between the timed catch event and that named activity, and do not add a further catch event for the same outcome.
rules.situation: the description says an event-based choice waits for one of several outcomes, one of which is a timed deadline, and that this timed outcome leads directly on to a further named activity

rules.instruction: When the description says that after a request for payment is sent, the process waits for one of several outcomes, and one of those outcomes is a stated deadline passing without the payment having arrived: Model the stated deadline as an intermediate timer catch event on its own outgoing branch of the event-based gateway that represents the wait. Place the other outcomes (payment received, disagreement) as catch events or receive tasks on the same gateway. Connect the timer's outgoing sequence flow directly to the next activity the description names for the deadline outcome. Do not connect the gateway straight to that activity, and do not replace the timed wait with an ordinary task.
rules.situation: the description says that after a request for payment is sent, the process waits for one of several outcomes, and one of those outcomes is a stated deadline passing without the payment having arrived

rules.instruction: When the description is written from the first-person view of a performing role that sends a request to an external party, and that party then acts on its own by paying, objecting, or letting a deadline pass, so the performing role must react to what the party does: Model the performing role as its own bpmn:participant pool and the external party as a separate bpmn:participant pool in the same collaboration. Connect the request sent by the performing role to the external party with a message flow, and connect the payment or objection returned by the external party back to the performing role with a message flow. Keep the performing role's internal steps, such as checking the case and closing it, inside its own pool.
rules.situation: the description is written from the first-person view of a performing role that sends a request to an external party, and that party then acts on its own by paying, objecting, or letting a deadline pass, so the performing role must react to what the party does
